limitations: Synthetic browser state and display-pound volume only; not Android/Room or owner acceptance.
Viewport width/font reflow checks; no native viewport-height, IME or physical phone proof.
Rest expiry uses accelerated browser clock, not Android timing.
Twelve saved sets per variant is a comparison capacity, not a new Temper product limit.
Prepared two-lift start only; existing Android start confirmation is outside this comparison.
